subject.facility_name: CURTIS HOME ST ELIZABETH CENTER, THE

executive_summary.text: PBJ-based estimate was below the Connecticut total direct-care comparison point in 3 quarter(s): 2023Q4, 2024Q2, 2025Q2.
Current operational/managerial control reported to CMS: BENJAMIN YEBOAH (since 05/13/2023); PATRICK MCDONNELL (since 06/24/2024).
Cost year 2025: total nursing pool (agency) fees on the report were $870,775, of which $428,112 is counted in direct care.

Cost year 2025: DSS's review changed 6 line(s) of the report, a net reduction of $23,603 in the costs DSS counts. Largest: Movable Equipment (page 22 line 7d), removed $12,933; Non Movable Equipment (page 22 line 7c), removed $9,858; Other Insurance (page 27 line 14c3), added $6,374. Separately, the home itself removed $697,844 from the costs it claimed (for example bad debt, pharmacy or therapy that the daily rate does not cover). The data shows each change, not the reason.
CMS lists 29 health citations for this home between 2019-01-14 and 2026-09-02, including 1 at actual harm or immediate jeopardy level (0 immediate jeopardy).
CMS lists 1 penalties, with fines totaling $10,358.00.

Missing data: cost year 2015 left out because the figures failed the site's checks (reasons under missing_data); No related parties or management-service payees were read from the cost year 2025 report. That means none were read, not that none exist.

Every year's full detail, including years left out here and the reason, is in https://danbeem.xyz/api/v1/facilities/075365/financials.json.

The filing is still listed in financials.json.

definitions.wages_reported: Salaries and wages printed on the cost report for that department. Not total department spending.
definitions.total_department_cost: Wages + allocated fringe + non-salary costs for the department, as computed by the site's cost-report build.
definitions.direct_care: DSS rate-setting definition: nursing and aide salaries, related fringe (allocated), and nursing pool (agency) cost.
definitions.figures: As filed by the home before DSS audit. Not Medicaid-allowable costs.
definitions.data_quality: Per year: status validated (core figures present, payer days add up, nothing out of range), unvalidated (read, but printed totals did not fully reconcile: treat as provisional) or check_failed (core figures missing or implausible: not used in reports). unusable_fields lists figures in that year that should not be quoted, with the reason.
definitions.raw_food_per_resident_day: Raw food cost / resident days. Only shown when the home buys its own food; when a contractor supplies meals the raw-food line is not comparable.
